title: Phase II study of Roginolisib in UM patients
official: A Phase II, Multi-centre, Open label, Randomised Study to Evaluate the Anti-tumour Activity of Roginolisib (IOA-244) in Patients with Advanced/Metastatic Ocular/Uveal Melanoma
summary: Main objective: To evaluate clinical efficacy of roginolisib, as single agent, against Investigator´s choice of therapy by assessment of OS
